g.text: A201 Hallway / A204 Bathroom 2 / A205 Utility
Width and height are the overall door sizes in the model, not the clear opening width used for egress checks.
"From / to" lists the rooms the model records on each side of the door; one room means an exterior door or a missing boundary.
Fire ratings are blank in the source model.
BSI (2020) "Duplex Apartment Test Files," buildingSMART International. License: CC BY 4.0.
Changes: drawings generated from the 3D model (duplex.ifc); the model itself is unchanged.
